meta.title: Bizarre Trek
meta.description: The future is shrouded in uncertainty, waiting for someone to uncover it...

units.rawText: At the Jovian Ringworld base.
units.displayText: At the Jovian Ringworld base.

spans.text: At the Jovian Ringworld base.

units.rawText: Xuannu leads her remaining troops home, and after returning to familiar territory, her tightly-wound nerves begin to relax.
units.displayText: Xuannu leads her remaining troops home, and after returning to familiar territory, her tightly-wound nerves begin to relax.

spans.text: Xuannu leads her remaining troops home, and after returning to familiar territory, her tightly-wound nerves begin to relax.

units.rawText: We have returned in triumph, Lady Xuannu.
units.displayText: We have returned in triumph, Lady Xuannu.

spans.text: We have returned in triumph, Lady Xuannu.

units.rawText: Gagarin... How are the other Saturnian satellites?
units.displayText: Gagarin... How are the other Saturnian satellites?

spans.text: Gagarin... How are the other Saturnian satellites?

units.rawText: Some of them are severely entropized and their data is damaged beyond repair. Requesting permission for reset.
units.displayText: Some of them are severely entropized and their data is damaged beyond repair. Requesting permission for reset.

spans.text: Some of them are severely entropized and their data is damaged beyond repair. Requesting permission for reset.

units.rawText: It's... it's not yet time.
units.displayText: It's... it's not yet time.

spans.text: It's... it's not yet time.

units.rawText: Xuannu frowns, then carefully examines the data on her terminal.
units.displayText: Xuannu frowns, then carefully examines the data on her terminal.

spans.text: Xuannu frowns, then carefully examines the data on her terminal.

units.rawText: Give me a report on our losses.
units.displayText: Give me a report on our losses.

spans.text: Give me a report on our losses.

units.rawText: We lost 35% of our mini-robots and 78% of our agent fighters during the decapitation operation. We've also lost 65% of our space exo-armors and 50% of our combat starships.
units.displayText: We lost 35% of our mini-robots and 78% of our agent fighters during the decapitation operation. We've also lost 65% of our space exo-armors and 50% of our combat starships.

spans.text: We lost 35% of our mini-robots and 78% of our agent fighters during the decapitation operation. We've also lost 65% of our space exo-armors and 50% of our combat starships.

units.rawText: We've performed emergency repairs on 35% of our gear and it is now ready for the next battle.
units.displayText: We've performed emergency repairs on 35% of our gear and it is now ready for the next battle.

spans.text: We've performed emergency repairs on 35% of our gear and it is now ready for the next battle.

units.rawText: What's the defense status of the other planetary systems?
units.displayText: What's the defense status of the other planetary systems?

spans.text: What's the defense status of the other planetary systems?

units.rawText: According to Yuwang's message, all is well for now.
units.displayText: According to Yuwang's message, all is well for now.

spans.text: According to Yuwang's message, all is well for now.

units.rawText: ...Where's Yuwang now?
units.displayText: ...Where's Yuwang now?

spans.text: ...Where's Yuwang now?

units.rawText: The logs show that he followed Team 08's report and went out to Uranus to search for what appeared to be the escape pod's signal.
units.displayText: The logs show that he followed Team 08's report and went out to Uranus to search for what appeared to be the escape pod's signal.

spans.text: The logs show that he followed Team 08's report and went out to Uranus to search for what appeared to be the escape pod's signal.

units.rawText: I see...
units.displayText: I see...

spans.text: I see...

units.rawText: Do you need me to contact him?
units.displayText: Do you need me to contact him?

spans.text: Do you need me to contact him?

units.rawText: No, let him go. The rest is our work.
units.displayText: No, let him go. The rest is our work.

spans.text: No, let him go. The rest is our work.

units.rawText: Xuannu returns her gaze to her terminal.
units.displayText: Xuannu returns her gaze to her terminal.

spans.text: Xuannu returns her gaze to her terminal.

units.rawText: Hm? What's wrong with this solar observation data?
units.displayText: Hm? What's wrong with this solar observation data?

spans.text: Hm? What's wrong with this solar observation data?

units.rawText: The collection of observation data has been put on hold for a while due to the fighting. Xuannu frowns when she sees the numbers on the screen.
units.displayText: The collection of observation data has been put on hold for a while due to the fighting. Xuannu frowns when she sees the numbers on the screen.

spans.text: The collection of observation data has been put on hold for a while due to the fighting. Xuannu frowns when she sees the numbers on the screen.

units.rawText: Put me through to the Mercury Observatory.
units.displayText: Put me through to the Mercury Observatory.

spans.text: Put me through to the Mercury Observatory.

units.rawText: Beepbeepbeep—
units.displayText: Beepbeepbeep—

spans.text: Beepbeepbeep—

units.rawText: Administrator, Mercury Base noted some data irregularities while studying the Sun. We've synced the new data to your terminal.
units.displayText: Administrator, Mercury Base noted some data irregularities while studying the Sun. We've synced the new data to your terminal.

spans.text: Administrator, Mercury Base noted some data irregularities while studying the Sun. We've synced the new data to your terminal.

units.rawText: When did this start?
units.displayText: When did this start?

spans.text: When did this start?

units.rawText: An hour ago. We discovered unnatural fluctuations in the Sun's temperature... Pzzzt... changes on the surface... Pzzzt...
units.displayText: An hour ago. We discovered unnatural fluctuations in the Sun's temperature... Pzzzt... changes on the surface... Pzzzt...

spans.text: An hour ago. We discovered unnatural fluctuations in the Sun's temperature... Pzzzt... changes on the surface... Pzzzt...

units.rawText: &￥...detecting great...%&￥solar... wind...
units.displayText: &￥...detecting great...%&￥solar... wind...

spans.text: &￥...detecting great...%&￥solar... wind...

units.rawText: ...Is it even affecting comms now?
units.displayText: ...Is it even affecting comms now?

spans.text: ...Is it even affecting comms now?

units.rawText: Gagarin, get a super high-speed shuttle ready... I'm heading over to Mercury now.
units.displayText: Gagarin, get a super high-speed shuttle ready... I'm heading over to Mercury now.

spans.text: Gagarin, get a super high-speed shuttle ready... I'm heading over to Mercury now.

units.rawText: Understood. Preparations will be complete in 10 seconds.
units.displayText: Understood. Preparations will be complete in 10 seconds.

spans.text: Understood. Preparations will be complete in 10 seconds.

units.rawText: Alright.
units.displayText: Alright.

spans.text: Alright.

units.rawText: As she studies the abnormal data on the screen, uneasiness begins brewing in Xuannu's heart.
units.displayText: As she studies the abnormal data on the screen, uneasiness begins brewing in Xuannu's heart.

spans.text: As she studies the abnormal data on the screen, uneasiness begins brewing in Xuannu's heart.

units.rawText: Oh yes... have you finished the preparations for backing up the sector's research data?
units.displayText: Oh yes... have you finished the preparations for backing up the sector's research data?

spans.text: Oh yes... have you finished the preparations for backing up the sector's research data?

units.rawText: The core data has been backed up. The rest will be done in roughly 2 hours.
units.displayText: The core data has been backed up. The rest will be done in roughly 2 hours.

spans.text: The core data has been backed up. The rest will be done in roughly 2 hours.

units.rawText: Load what's done onto the super high-speed shuttle as planned.
units.displayText: Load what's done onto the super high-speed shuttle as planned.

spans.text: Load what's done onto the super high-speed shuttle as planned.

units.rawText: Once I leave, remain in the base and meet Xinghuan and Yuwang when they return from Uranus.
units.displayText: Once I leave, remain in the base and meet Xinghuan and Yuwang when they return from Uranus.

spans.text: Once I leave, remain in the base and meet Xinghuan and Yuwang when they return from Uranus.

units.rawText: Understood.
units.displayText: Understood.

spans.text: Understood.

units.rawText: Jiutian sector, in the Uranian system.
units.displayText: Jiutian sector, in the Uranian system.

spans.text: Jiutian sector, in the Uranian system.

units.rawText: A retro-style spaceship travels through Uranian space, towards its destination planet.
units.displayText: A retro-style spaceship travels through Uranian space, towards its destination planet.

spans.text: A retro-style spaceship travels through Uranian space, towards its destination planet.

units.rawText: There was a massive operand fluctuation from Saturn just now... I hope we make it in time...
units.displayText: There was a massive operand fluctuation from Saturn just now... I hope we make it in time...

spans.text: There was a massive operand fluctuation from Saturn just now... I hope we make it in time...

units.rawText: I'm sure we'll meet through the guidance of the stars...
units.displayText: I'm sure we'll meet through the guidance of the stars...

spans.text: I'm sure we'll meet through the guidance of the stars...

units.rawText: Asteroid belt detected. Miss Hubble, Miss Fresnel, please strap yourselves in.
units.displayText: Asteroid belt detected. Miss Hubble, Miss Fresnel, please strap yourselves in.

spans.text: Asteroid belt detected. Miss Hubble, Miss Fresnel, please strap yourselves in.

units.rawText: Belka, why is there such a dense debris belt here?
units.displayText: Belka, why is there such a dense debris belt here?

spans.text: Belka, why is there such a dense debris belt here?

units.rawText: Collapse of the outer satellites of the Solar System and asteroid entropization mean that countless celestial bodies are on the verge of destruction.
units.displayText: Collapse of the outer satellites of the Solar System and asteroid entropization mean that countless celestial bodies are on the verge of destruction.

spans.text: Collapse of the outer satellites of the Solar System and asteroid entropization mean that countless celestial bodies are on the verge of destruction.

units.rawText: Their remains have drifted here, where they were caught by Oberon's gravity and became a debris belt...
units.displayText: Their remains have drifted here, where they were caught by Oberon's gravity and became a debris belt...

spans.text: Their remains have drifted here, where they were caught by Oberon's gravity and became a debris belt...

units.rawText: It's like the heat death...
units.displayText: It's like the heat death...

spans.text: It's like the heat death...

units.rawText: (Sigh) Man, why is Jiutian sector like this...
units.displayText: (Sigh) Man, why is Jiutian sector like this...

spans.text: (Sigh) Man, why is Jiutian sector like this...

units.rawText: Beepbeep, beepbeep, beepbeep...
units.displayText: Beepbeep, beepbeep, beepbeep...

spans.text: Beepbeep, beepbeep, beepbeep...

units.rawText: Just as Fresnel is about to max out the vessel's throttle, the spaceship's radio suddenly picks up a strange signal.
units.displayText: Just as Fresnel is about to max out the vessel's throttle, the spaceship's radio suddenly picks up a strange signal.

spans.text: Just as Fresnel is about to max out the vessel's throttle, the spaceship's radio suddenly picks up a strange signal.

units.rawText: What's wrong?
units.displayText: What's wrong?

spans.text: What's wrong?

units.rawText: It's a distress signal on the sector's public-access channel. Detecting an unknown object on the port side of the vessel. Presumably, the signal is coming from there.
units.displayText: It's a distress signal on the sector's public-access channel. Detecting an unknown object on the port side of the vessel. Presumably, the signal is coming from there.

spans.text: It's a distress signal on the sector's public-access channel. Detecting an unknown object on the port side of the vessel. Presumably, the signal is coming from there.

units.rawText: We'll bring it in with the ship's portside manipulator arm.
units.displayText: We'll bring it in with the ship's portside manipulator arm.

spans.text: We'll bring it in with the ship's portside manipulator arm.

units.rawText: <size=40>Wait!</size>
units.displayText: Wait!

spans.text: Wait!

units.rawText: What's wrong, Hubble?
units.displayText: What's wrong, Hubble?

spans.text: What's wrong, Hubble?

units.rawText: A sinister gleam...
units.displayText: A sinister gleam...

spans.text: A sinister gleam...

units.rawText: Hubble points to the monitor; in addition to the red dot that's broadcasting a rescue signal, there are scattered blinking lights rapidly approaching them.
units.displayText: Hubble points to the monitor; in addition to the red dot that's broadcasting a rescue signal, there are scattered blinking lights rapidly approaching them.

spans.text: Hubble points to the monitor; in addition to the red dot that's broadcasting a rescue signal, there are scattered blinking lights rapidly approaching them.

units.rawText: Give me a visual on them.
units.displayText: Give me a visual on them.

spans.text: Give me a visual on them.

units.rawText: A battered escape pod floats through the void, pursued by a swarm of dark purple creatures not far off.
units.displayText: A battered escape pod floats through the void, pursued by a swarm of dark purple creatures not far off.

spans.text: A battered escape pod floats through the void, pursued by a swarm of dark purple creatures not far off.

units.rawText: Entropics!
units.displayText: Entropics!

spans.text: Entropics!

units.rawText: <size=40>Can't those monsters give it a break?!</size>
units.displayText: Can't those monsters give it a break?!

spans.text: Can't those monsters give it a break?!

units.rawText: We cannot just sit back as the hope of the stars falls into darkness.
units.displayText: We cannot just sit back as the hope of the stars falls into darkness.

spans.text: We cannot just sit back as the hope of the stars falls into darkness.

units.rawText: Arming port anti-air missiles, direction 4 o'clock, range 30, FIRE!!!
units.displayText: Arming port anti-air missiles, direction 4 o'clock, range 30, FIRE!!!

spans.text: Arming port anti-air missiles, direction 4 o'clock, range 30, FIRE!!!

units.rawText: The missile pod below the port side of the spaceship opens, and eight missiles fire off in a rapid burst.
units.displayText: The missile pod below the port side of the spaceship opens, and eight missiles fire off in a rapid burst.

spans.text: The missile pod below the port side of the spaceship opens, and eight missiles fire off in a rapid burst.

units.rawText: Grah—
units.displayText: Grah—

spans.text: Grah—

units.rawText: After the dark purple smoke clouds fade, only half the original amount of entropics remain near the escape pod. While they're still cowering from the missile blasts, Fresnel has already given another command to the system.
units.displayText: After the dark purple smoke clouds fade, only half the original amount of entropics remain near the escape pod. While they're still cowering from the missile blasts, Fresnel has already given another command to the system.

spans.text: After the dark purple smoke clouds fade, only half the original amount of entropics remain near the escape pod. While they're still cowering from the missile blasts, Fresnel has already given another command to the system.

units.rawText: Portside manipulator arm, recover the pod!
units.displayText: Portside manipulator arm, recover the pod!

spans.text: Portside manipulator arm, recover the pod!

units.rawText: A metallic mechanical arm emerges from the spaceship's portside armor and securely grips the escape pod. The remaining entropics immediately respond by launching a mad charge at the mechanical arm.
units.displayText: A metallic mechanical arm emerges from the spaceship's portside armor and securely grips the escape pod. The remaining entropics immediately respond by launching a mad charge at the mechanical arm.

spans.text: A metallic mechanical arm emerges from the spaceship's portside armor and securely grips the escape pod. The remaining entropics immediately respond by launching a mad charge at the mechanical arm.

units.rawText: Tsk!
units.displayText: Tsk!

spans.text: Tsk!

units.rawText: Fresnel immediately throws the vessel's rudder fully to the right and the spaceship accelerates dramatically after doing so. In the blink of an eye, they are out of the entropics' pursuit range.
units.displayText: Fresnel immediately throws the vessel's rudder fully to the right and the spaceship accelerates dramatically after doing so. In the blink of an eye, they are out of the entropics' pursuit range.

spans.text: Fresnel immediately throws the vessel's rudder fully to the right and the spaceship accelerates dramatically after doing so. In the blink of an eye, they are out of the entropics' pursuit range.

units.rawText: Whew— that was way more exciting than in training. Now what should we do? I've never seen anything like this before in the Oasis.
units.displayText: Whew— that was way more exciting than in training. Now what should we do? I've never seen anything like this before in the Oasis.

spans.text: Whew— that was way more exciting than in training. Now what should we do? I've never seen anything like this before in the Oasis.

units.rawText: The stars have gathered and our destinies are resonating. Belka, can you try to open it?
units.displayText: The stars have gathered and our destinies are resonating. Belka, can you try to open it?

spans.text: The stars have gathered and our destinies are resonating. Belka, can you try to open it?

units.rawText: This is an escape pod from the Jiutian's Titan Base. It is similar to analogous devices from Haumea Station. Perhaps entering the correct code will open it.
units.displayText: This is an escape pod from the Jiutian's Titan Base. It is similar to analogous devices from Haumea Station. Perhaps entering the correct code will open it.

spans.text: This is an escape pod from the Jiutian's Titan Base. It is similar to analogous devices from Haumea Station. Perhaps entering the correct code will open it.

units.rawText: Belka connects the escape pod to the computer and tries to enter the right access code. A while later, the pod door opens with a "click".
units.displayText: Belka connects the escape pod to the computer and tries to enter the right access code. A while later, the pod door opens with a "click".

spans.text: Belka connects the escape pod to the computer and tries to enter the right access code. A while later, the pod door opens with a "click".

units.rawText: Verifying agent ID...
units.displayText: Verifying agent ID...

spans.text: Verifying agent ID...

units.rawText: Fresnel and Hubble carefully lean over to look, and they see a wounded Doll curled up inside the cramped confines of the pod; a friend that Hubble has not seen in a long time.
units.displayText: Fresnel and Hubble carefully lean over to look, and they see a wounded Doll curled up inside the cramped confines of the pod; a friend that Hubble has not seen in a long time.

spans.text: Fresnel and Hubble carefully lean over to look, and they see a wounded Doll curled up inside the cramped confines of the pod; a friend that Hubble has not seen in a long time.

units.rawText: Xinghuan?!
units.displayText: Xinghuan?!

spans.text: Xinghuan?!

units.rawText: Xinghuan, please wake up... Xinghuan...
units.displayText: Xinghuan, please wake up... Xinghuan...

spans.text: Xinghuan, please wake up... Xinghuan...

units.rawText: (Groans) I...
units.displayText: (Groans) I...

spans.text: (Groans) I...

units.rawText: Xinghuan slowly opens her eyes.
units.displayText: Xinghuan slowly opens her eyes.

spans.text: Xinghuan slowly opens her eyes.

units.rawText: Xinghuan, are you alright?
units.displayText: Xinghuan, are you alright?

spans.text: Xinghuan, are you alright?

units.rawText: Hub...ble... I must be dreaming, huh...
units.displayText: Hub...ble... I must be dreaming, huh...

spans.text: Hub...ble... I must be dreaming, huh...

units.rawText: No, it's not a dream, I'm really here.
units.displayText: No, it's not a dream, I'm really here.

spans.text: No, it's not a dream, I'm really here.

units.rawText: As Xinghuan is enveloped in warm operands, her chaotic operating processes slowly return to normal.
units.displayText: As Xinghuan is enveloped in warm operands, her chaotic operating processes slowly return to normal.

spans.text: As Xinghuan is enveloped in warm operands, her chaotic operating processes slowly return to normal.

units.rawText: But if I'm not dreaming... then why is Hubble here... Where am I...
units.displayText: But if I'm not dreaming... then why is Hubble here... Where am I...

spans.text: But if I'm not dreaming... then why is Hubble here... Where am I...

units.rawText: Right, Titan! Ugh...
units.displayText: Right, Titan! Ugh...

spans.text: Right, Titan! Ugh...

units.rawText: Xinghuan straightens up, but she winces from the pain of the wound on her side and collapses again.
units.displayText: Xinghuan straightens up, but she winces from the pain of the wound on her side and collapses again.

spans.text: Xinghuan straightens up, but she winces from the pain of the wound on her side and collapses again.

units.rawText: Don't move, you're very weak now.
units.displayText: Don't move, you're very weak now.

spans.text: Don't move, you're very weak now.

units.rawText: You're hurt all over... What on earth did you go through?
units.displayText: You're hurt all over... What on earth did you go through?

spans.text: You're hurt all over... What on earth did you go through?

units.rawText: Ah... yeah... the escape pod...
units.displayText: Ah... yeah... the escape pod...

spans.text: Ah... yeah... the escape pod...

units.rawText: Did I meet you because the escape pod went out of control? Lucky me, I guess...
units.displayText: Did I meet you because the escape pod went out of control? Lucky me, I guess...

spans.text: Did I meet you because the escape pod went out of control? Lucky me, I guess...

units.rawText: Hehe, perhaps the stars really were guiding you.
units.displayText: Hehe, perhaps the stars really were guiding you.

spans.text: Hehe, perhaps the stars really were guiding you.

units.rawText: All we can do is give you some basic first aid for your wounds. We have an entropic suppressor for you, just in case.
units.displayText: All we can do is give you some basic first aid for your wounds. We have an entropic suppressor for you, just in case.

spans.text: All we can do is give you some basic first aid for your wounds. We have an entropic suppressor for you, just in case.

units.rawText: Currently, there don't seem to be any signs of entropization. However... We really do need to find better medical supplies and facilities for you so we can give you more advanced care.
units.displayText: Currently, there don't seem to be any signs of entropization. However... We really do need to find better medical supplies and facilities for you so we can give you more advanced care.

spans.text: Currently, there don't seem to be any signs of entropization. However... We really do need to find better medical supplies and facilities for you so we can give you more advanced care.

units.rawText: Belka, are there any resource satellites nearby with medical facilities?
units.displayText: Belka, are there any resource satellites nearby with medical facilities?

spans.text: Belka, are there any resource satellites nearby with medical facilities?

units.rawText: There is an observation base on Oberon. It contains some mechanical repair and first aid facilities.
units.displayText: There is an observation base on Oberon. It contains some mechanical repair and first aid facilities.

spans.text: There is an observation base on Oberon. It contains some mechanical repair and first aid facilities.

units.rawText: However, Oberon has been attacked by the entropics and conditions on the surface are unknown.
units.displayText: However, Oberon has been attacked by the entropics and conditions on the surface are unknown.

spans.text: However, Oberon has been attacked by the entropics and conditions on the surface are unknown.

units.rawText: We're a long way from the other Uranian moons and there aren't any other resource satellites in sight. Oberon's our best choice.
units.displayText: We're a long way from the other Uranian moons and there aren't any other resource satellites in sight. Oberon's our best choice.

spans.text: We're a long way from the other Uranian moons and there aren't any other resource satellites in sight. Oberon's our best choice.

units.rawText: Mm, then we'll stop over at Oberon.
units.displayText: Mm, then we'll stop over at Oberon.

spans.text: Mm, then we'll stop over at Oberon.

units.rawText: We've managed to stabilize your current injuries for now, at least...
units.displayText: We've managed to stabilize your current injuries for now, at least...

spans.text: We've managed to stabilize your current injuries for now, at least...

units.rawText: Just leave it to me. We'll be at Oberon Base in five minutes. The landing might be a bit rough, so be careful.
units.displayText: Just leave it to me. We'll be at Oberon Base in five minutes. The landing might be a bit rough, so be careful.

spans.text: Just leave it to me. We'll be at Oberon Base in five minutes. The landing might be a bit rough, so be careful.

units.rawText: Fresnel puts the pedal to the metal and after severe shaking and some turbulence, the spaceship successfully enters Oberon's atmosphere, landing outside the base.
units.displayText: Fresnel puts the pedal to the metal and after severe shaking and some turbulence, the spaceship successfully enters Oberon's atmosphere, landing outside the base.

spans.text: Fresnel puts the pedal to the metal and after severe shaking and some turbulence, the spaceship successfully enters Oberon's atmosphere, landing outside the base.

units.rawText: Fresnel, since our manpower is limited, you should stay behind and take care of Xinghuan while I go into the base to look for medical supplies and facilities.
units.displayText: Fresnel, since our manpower is limited, you should stay behind and take care of Xinghuan while I go into the base to look for medical supplies and facilities.

spans.text: Fresnel, since our manpower is limited, you should stay behind and take care of Xinghuan while I go into the base to look for medical supplies and facilities.

units.rawText: I'll go too, if there are entropics... (winces)
units.displayText: I'll go too, if there are entropics... (winces)

spans.text: I'll go too, if there are entropics... (winces)

units.rawText: Xinghuan tries to stand up, but she moves too much and accidentally jostles her wound.
units.displayText: Xinghuan tries to stand up, but she moves too much and accidentally jostles her wound.

spans.text: Xinghuan tries to stand up, but she moves too much and accidentally jostles her wound.

units.rawText: You haven't recovered yet. I'll go down there with Hubble. If there are entropics around, at least I can help her out.
units.displayText: You haven't recovered yet. I'll go down there with Hubble. If there are entropics around, at least I can help her out.

spans.text: You haven't recovered yet. I'll go down there with Hubble. If there are entropics around, at least I can help her out.

units.rawText: The ship's automated defenses should be able to keep you safe. I'll leave Xinghuan to you, Belka.
units.displayText: The ship's automated defenses should be able to keep you safe. I'll leave Xinghuan to you, Belka.

spans.text: The ship's automated defenses should be able to keep you safe. I'll leave Xinghuan to you, Belka.

units.rawText: Roger!
units.displayText: Roger!

spans.text: Roger!

units.rawText: At Oberon Base.
units.displayText: At Oberon Base.

spans.text: At Oberon Base.

units.rawText: Fresnel pushes aside the messy tables and chairs, and a chill runs through her core as she looks at the ruined base before her.
units.displayText: Fresnel pushes aside the messy tables and chairs, and a chill runs through her core as she looks at the ruined base before her.

spans.text: Fresnel pushes aside the messy tables and chairs, and a chill runs through her core as she looks at the ruined base before her.

units.rawText: Looks like... this place was abandoned, too.
units.displayText: Looks like... this place was abandoned, too.

spans.text: Looks like... this place was abandoned, too.

units.rawText: Xinghuan said everyone evacuated from here three days ago...
units.displayText: Xinghuan said everyone evacuated from here three days ago...

spans.text: Xinghuan said everyone evacuated from here three days ago...

units.displayText: Hubble picks up a sheaf of documents inside the Ops Room. It contains densely-packed records of Uranian observation logs.

spans.text: Hubble picks up a sheaf of documents inside the Ops Room. It contains densely-packed records of Uranian observation logs.

units.rawText: Before they withdrew... They were still focused on their observation duties.
